description.zh: 时间周期调度的Cron表达式。
description.en: The cron expression for the recurring schedule.

description.zh: 自动快照策略的名称。长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（\_）或者短划线（-）。默认值：空。
description.en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy. It can contain 2 to 128 English or Chinese characters. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), or hyphens (-). Default value: empty.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. For more information, see [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) to get a list of regions supported by WUYING Workspace.

description.zh: 自动快照的保留时间，单位为天。取值范围：1\~180。
description.en: The retention period of the automatic snapshot, in days. Valid values: 1 to 180.
